theorem lg_target (x : ℝ) {t p : ℝ} (hp : 0 ≤ p) (ht : t ≠ 0) : |x| ^ p ≤ (p / |t|) ^ p * max (Real.exp (t * x)) (Real.exp (-t * x)) := by
  have h1 : max (Real.exp (t * x)) (Real.exp (-t * x)) = Real.cosh (t * x) := by
    rw [Real.max_eq]
    split
    · exact le_refl _
    · exact le_refl _
  rw [h1]
  have h2 : Real.cosh (t * x) ≥ 1 := by
    apply Real.cosh_ge_one
  have h3 : (p / |t|) ^ p ≥ 0 := by
    apply pow_nonneg
    exact hp
  have h4 : (p / |t|) ^ p * Real.cosh (t * x) ≥ Real.cosh (t * x) := by
    apply mul_le_mul_right
    exact h2
  have h5 : |x| ^ p ≤ (p / |t|) ^ p * Real.cosh (t * x) := by
    apply le_trans
    apply Real.exp_le_cosh_add_mul_sinh ht
    apply Real.exp_le_cosh_add_mul_sinh (Real.neg ht)
    apply le_div_of_le_mul h3 h4
  exact h5
